Zero is open and one forbids placement, but forbidden cells do not block attacks. Place exactly three indistinguishable queens so that no two share a row, column or diagonal in either direction. Rows may be left empty, and count each set of occupied cells once regardless of placement order. What is the number of legal placements, as a whole number?

follow_up.question: What are safe worst-case time and space bounds for the row-based placement search?
follow_up.reference: The optional-row search is exponential; O(n times (n plus one) to the n) is a conservative time bound. It uses O(n) recursion space with word-sized masks on these boards, and processing rows in order counts each occupied-cell set once.
